description: Source code for handling tar archive operations including listing, extracting, adding, and deleting files, with support for various compression types and parsing output lines.

methods.name: isTar
methods.description: Checks if a given file is a tar archive by inspecting its magic bytes.

methods.name: xa_tar_get_compressor_type
methods.description: Determines the compressor type based on the archive's type.

methods.name: xa_tar_ask
methods.description: Sets capabilities and properties for the archive based on its compressor type.

methods.name: xa_tar_parse_output
methods.description: Parses a line of output from tar listing to extract file information.

methods.name: xa_tar_list
methods.description: Lists contents of a tar archive and populates a list store for display.

methods.name: xa_tar_extract
methods.description: Extracts specified files from a tar archive.

methods.name: xa_tar_add
methods.description: Adds files to a tar archive, creating or updating as needed.

methods.name: xa_tar_delete
methods.description: Deletes specified files from a tar archive.
